clue.text: Reporter's first to join our new celebrity team

definitions.note: read as 'reporter is', so the definition is the noun reporter

indicators.note: the first letter of the word join is the one taken

clue.text: Hi — this is a kidnap! Tell him you're all right

definitions.text: Hi — this is a kidnap! Tell him you're all right

clue.text: Do nothing to keep innings going?

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes making no effort whatsoever, a common figurative phrase for laziness.
